clips.title: The story
paras: Foreman Thistlenettle's badge is all that remains after the collapse in the Deadmines.

Before the Defias Brotherhood sealed Moonbrook and the tunnels beneath it, dwarven prospectors from Ironforge's Explorers' League worked the old gold mines of Westfall. Foreman Thistlenettle and his crew were deep underground when a tunnel collapsed and split them apart. His brother Wilder escaped to Stormwind City, but the foreman and several laborers were left trapped below.
